import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int u, v;
        long cap, flow;
        long cost;
        Edge(int u, int v, long cap, long flow, long cost) {
            this.u = u;
            this.v = v;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
        long rem() {
            return cap - flow;
        }
    }

    static int nodes;
    static List<Integer>[] g;
    static List<Edge> e;
    static final long INF = 100000000000000L;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap, long cost) {
        g[u].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost));
        g[v].add(e.size());
        e.add(new Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost));
    }

    static long[] dist;
    static long[] cap;
    static int[] pre;
    static boolean[] inq;
    static long mncost;
    static long mxflow;

    static void flow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(inq, false);
        mxflow = 0;
        mncost = 0;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(pre, -1);
            pre[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(cap, 0);
            cap[s] = INF;
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            inq[s] = true;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                inq[u] = false;
                for (int it : g[u]) {
                    Edge f = e.get(it);
                    if (f.rem() > 0 && dist[f.v] > dist[u] + f.cost + 1e-9) {
                        dist[f.v] = dist[u] + f.cost;
                        pre[f.v] = it;
                        cap[f.v] = Math.min(cap[u], f.rem());
                        if (!inq[f.v]) {
                            q.offer(f.v);
                            inq[f.v] = true;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if (pre[t] < 0) {
                break;
            }
            long flowAmount = cap[t];
            mxflow += flowAmount;
            mncost += flowAmount * dist[t];
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                Edge ePre = e.get(pre[v]);
                ePre.flow += flowAmount;
                e.get(pre[v] ^ 1).flow -= flowAmount;
                v = ePre.u;
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st;

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        g = new ArrayList[8200];
        for (int i = 0; i < g.length; i++) {
            g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        e = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            x--;
            addEdge(0, x + 1, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int x = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int y = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            x--;
            y--;
            for (int j = 0; j < 105; j++) {
                for (int jj = 0; jj < 51; jj++) {
                    addEdge(i * n + x + 1, (i + 1) * n + y + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * jj + 1));
                    addEdge(i * n + y + 1, (i + 1) * n + x + 1, 1, c + d * (2 * jj + 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                addEdge(i * n + j + 1, (i + 1) * n + j + 1, 51, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 105; i++) {
            addEdge(i * n + 1, 105 * n + 1, 51, 0);
        }

        nodes = 6 + 107 * n;
        dist = new long[nodes];
        pre = new int[nodes];
        inq = new boolean[nodes];
        cap = new long[nodes];

        flow(0, 105 * n + 1);
        System.out.println(mncost);
    }
}
